What does "A2" mean?

Indian desi breeds like Sahiwal and Rathi give milk with only the A2 type of beta-casein protein. Most dairy milk, from crossbreed cows, carries both A1 and A2.

Our story · बरोसी As seen onSeason 2 · 2023

Named after a pit in the ground

"After school, Maa gave us milk straight from a clay pot that had sat for hours in the barosi."

A barosi is a small pit lined with cow-dung cakes. Milk warms in it for hours on a low flame and picks up an earthy aroma no factory can copy. Founder Durlabh Rawat grew up with that taste in a village in Uttar Pradesh, spent 12 years in the auto sector, then started Barosi to bring that milk to the city.

      What we changed, and why it pays

      Build order: Shop all, Milk picker and Our promise first. They reuse prices and photos Barosi already has.

      Growth conversion, AOV, repeatBrand trust, recall, identity
      #SectionEarlierNowLensWhy it mattersTrack
      1Announcement barNo delivery or cut-off info on the homepage5–9 am, 7 days; change till 9:30 pmGrowthMilk goes out 365 days; care answers Mon–Sat, 9–8. Answers on the page are calls the team never takes.Support calls, trial bookings
      2Entry & headerForced Gurugram / Pan India splash; login looks like a linkChoice remembered, nav by how people shop, visible Log inGrowthMeta CAC in Indian D2C is up 32% in a year (₹380 → ₹502). Going straight to products makes every paid visit count.Splash bounce, self-serve pauses
      3HeroText baked into a "Delivered Fresh" bannerBarosi story slide, live buttons, 3 proof pointsBrandGrowthText inside an image can't be indexed or tracked per button. "Barosi" is the one asset no rival can copy.Hero CTR, bounce
      4Which milk is for me?Two cards; no difference, no monthly costFour one-tap needs, one-line why, monthly costBrandGrowthConsumables repeat 30–45% vs ~25% Indian D2C average. A2 at 1 L/day is ₹3,360 a month, shown before signup, so the first bill is no surprise.Trials, A2 share, trial → subscription
      5Shop allNo product or price; 20 ghee listings, one per sizePrices on the homepage; size chips swap photo, price, ₹/LGrowthA2 ghee: ₹1,730/L at 500 ml, ₹1,580/L at 5 L: 9% cheaper. Per-litre maths sells the bigger jar. First price goes from 2 clicks to 0.ATC rate, 1 L+ size mix
      6Our promiseIcon tiles; test report link not live yet6-step photo journey, daily test slip, ghee lab numbersBrandGrowthA 3★ buyer on Barosi's ghee page would buy 3 kg a month if lab reports were sent. Showing proof can unlock repeat orders.Report views → trials
      7CombosOnly same-ghee multipacks5 cross-category combos at ~9–10% offGrowth₹1,099 duo = 27% more than a lone ₹865 jar for ₹116 off; the trio = 63% more. Hold back 10% of visitors to prove it's incremental.AOV, attach rate
      8Our storyImage banner linking awayMaa's barosi story, founder, Shark Tank badge, farm visitBrandRivals can copy a bottle, not an origin. Founder and Shark Tank now sit on the homepage; a farm visit already won over Kiran's family.Farm visits, story → trial
      9PostcardsOne testimonial at a timeFaces + photo reviews in one row, badgesBrandGrowthPhoto reviews beat text where the doubt is "is it real?". Reviews show newest first today; leading with happy local faces sets the first impression.Review views → trials
      10RecipesRepeating blog carousel, no recipesPostcard recipes with full recipe pagesBrandGrowthGhee is a consumable: the second order is the number. Recipes give a reason to finish the jar. Seasonal dishes got the most shares in our audit (halwa reel: 7.0k).Recipe → ATC, repeat rate
